data.narrative:
Amogy, a Series C climate and energy company founded by Seonghoon Woo, has raised over $300M and carries a last post-money valuation of $700M. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of 9 comparable companies across the climate and energy sector—1 public (Enovix, trading at ~$1.0B market cap) and 8 private firms including KoBold Metals ($3.0B), Electric Hydrogen ($1.0B), and Solid Power ($504M as public).

Two methodologies triangulate Amogy's forward value. Stage-progression analysis applies a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C advancement, yielding $1.2B from the $700M base. Peer-median analysis across the 4 most comparable same-sector companies generates a $1.0B implied valuation, with the full peer range spanning $504M to $3.0B. These approaches yield a median implied value of $1.1B, with low and high scenarios anchoring at $850M and $1.4B respectively.

The $1.1B median sits modestly above the current post-money, reflecting modest step-up expectations for Series C progression in a competitive subsector. Key sensitivities include comparative technology readiness relative to peers and market conditions affecting downstream capital availability. The $550M spread between low and high scenarios ($850M–$1.4B) captures variance in peer comparability and stage-advancement assumptions.
